statusRule: Endpoint reachability is PROBE_GREEN only. A layer is not counted fixed until the exact product contract and real browser map path are proven. Source failure must never be rendered as zero/no records.

currentSandboxCandidate.note: Head may advance after this status write. Re-resolve PR #72 before making any acceptance claim.

timeEngine.next: Extend the same semantic time-axis contract to other temporal sources only after their base map contracts are solid.

emodnet-bathymetry.truthBoundary: Bathymetry is seabed depth/product coverage, not ecological condition or event.

emodnet-seabed-habitats.latestFailureEvidence: On b3a80b59 lineage the source endpoint remained PROBE_GREEN, but the continental exact WMS contract timed out and the pixel-aware candidate sweep produced no current non-transparent candidate evidence. This is a layer-contract failure, not zero/no habitat records.
emodnet-seabed-habitats.currentRepair: Exact probe now uses a bounded z7 North Sea MapLibre tile request to test the same current MSFD 800 WMS product at real tiled-map scale. Deployed desktop/mobile MAP_GREEN is still mandatory and has not been inferred from the probe.
emodnet-seabed-habitats.truthBoundary: EUSeaMap is predictive habitat classification, not direct field observation, absence evidence or current ecological condition.

emodnet-dissolved-oxygen-climatology.truthBoundary: Monthly climatology is a long-term seasonal condition pattern, not a live oxygen reading or proof of hypoxia.

emodnet-fishing-vessel-density.truthBoundary: Historical AIS-derived vessel-density context, not live fishing, catch, legality or ecological impact.

nasa-eonet.repair: Hosted runtime uses bounded same-origin atlas-feed proxy. Failure throws; it is not represented as zero or no events.
nasa-eonet.truthBoundary: Provider-reported open natural events are not automatically local alerts or ecological-impact determinations.

climate-trace.repair: Replaced stale v6 /assets adapter with current public v7 /sources. Empty/contract mismatch now fails explicitly instead of rendering misleading zero.
climate-trace.boundedEvidence: 2024 power, co2e_100yr, limit 5 returned five real sources with coordinates and emissions.
climate-trace.truthBoundary: Climate TRACE source records are emitting assets with reported/estimated emissions, not live plumes and not proof of legal liability.

noaa-coral-reef-watch.repair: Current NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP DHW product is delivered through an allowlisted same-origin bridge that converts MapLibre EPSG:3857 bounds to supported CRS:84.
noaa-coral-reef-watch.truthBoundary: Degree Heating Week is heat-stress pressure, not observed coral bleaching.

gbif.truthBoundary: Occurrence and recording density are not abundance, range or live position.

obis.truthBoundary: Occurrence records are not live whale positions or migration routes.

nasa-gibs.note: Each exact product is separately contract-probed because a green GIBS capabilities endpoint does not guarantee every dated layer request.

emodnet-physics.nextUse: Ocean conditions candidate: currents/waves/physical ocean variables after current repair gate closes.

ices-datras.nextUse: Research-trawl survey context with survey-design semantics preserved.

inaturalist.note: Taxon/photo use exists elsewhere; observation and media licences/geoprivacy must be handled separately.

remaining: confirm intended 4PLANET use against API terms
global-fishing-watch.truthBoundary: Apparent fishing effort is algorithmic AIS-derived activity estimation, not proof of illegal fishing, catch or complete vessel presence.

programmeBoundary: Nothing in this status authorises production merge or deployment. Stable sandbox evidence is a prerequisite for later founder promotion review.
